analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to supervise [product_name] using [product_name] runtime software on a PC, avoiding hardware panels, by connecting over Ethernet. The main concern is that [company_name] engineering software version [version_no] and [product_name] Basic [version_no] do not directly support Runtime communication with [product_name] devices, resulting in uncertainty about which software versions and combinations will allow the desired setup.
